items.title: Josh Allen: Three total TDs in Week 10 win
items.text:
Allen completed 11 of 21 passes for 196 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing five times for five yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.

items.title: Bijan Robinson: Solid numbers in blowout loss
items.text:
Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: James Cook: Breaks off 74-yard rushing TD
items.text:
Cook rushed 18 times for 157 yards and a touchdown but didn't catch his only target in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
